deployment_name.description: The Databricks workspace deployment name: the host prefix of the workspace URL (dbc-abcd0123-a1bc on AWS, adb-1234567890123456.7 on Azure, 1234567890123456 on GCP). Set DATABRICKS_DEPLOYMENT_NAME to default it for the session.

workspace_domain.description: The Databricks workspace domain suffix for the cloud. Selected by DATABRICKS_CLOUD (aws, azure or gcp; default aws).
